lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਏ ਹਮ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਰਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: prabh paae ham avar na bhaariaa ||7||
lines.translation: I have found God - I am not searching for any other. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚ ਮਹਲਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach mahal gur alakh lakhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the unseen Mansion of the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਹਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal mahal nahee chhaaiaa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: His Mansion is eternal and unchanging; it is not a mere reflection of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: saach sa(n)tokhe bharam chukaaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Through truth and contentment, doubt is dispelled. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai man vasiaa sach soee ||
lines.translation: That person, within whose mind the True Lord dwells

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat guramukh hoee ||
lines.translation: in his company, one becomes Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥੯॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saach naam mal khoee ||9||15||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Name washes off the pollution. ||9||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam chit raapai jaa kaa ||
lines.translation: One whose consciousness is permeated with the Lord's Name

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਜੰਪਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: upaja(n)p darasan keejai taa kaa ||1||
lines.translation: - receive the blessing of his darshan in the early light of dawn. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam na japahu abhaag tumaaraa ||
lines.translation: If you do not meditate on the Lord, it is your own misfortune.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug jug daataa prabh raam hamaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In each and every age, the Great Giver is my Lord God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat raam japai jan pooraa ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the perfect humble beings meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghat anahat baaje tooraa ||2||
lines.translation: Within their hearts, the unstruck melody vibrates. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan raam bhagat har piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who worship the Lord and love the Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: se prabh raakhe kirapaa dhaar ||3||
lines.translation: - showering His Mercy, God protects them. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai hiradai har har soee ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the Lord, Har, Har

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tin kaa daras paras sukh hoee ||4||
lines.translation: - gazing upon the blessed vision of their darshan, peace is obtained. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab jeeaa mahi eko ravai ||
lines.translation: Among all beings, the One Lord is pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh aha(n)kaaree phir joonee bhavai ||5||
lines.translation: The eogtistical, self-willed manmukhs wander in reincarnation. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so boojhai jo satigur paae ||
lines.translation: They alone understand, who have found the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maare gurasabade paae ||6||
lines.translation: Subduing their ego, they receive the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aradh uradh kee sa(n)dh kiu jaanai ||
lines.translation: How can anyone know of the Union between the being below and the Supreme Being above?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sa(n)dh milai man maanai ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs obtain this Union; their minds are reconciliated. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham paapee niragun kau gun kareeai ||
lines.translation: I am a worthless sinner, without merit. What merit do I have?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: prabh hoi daiaal naanak jan tareeai ||8||16||
lines.translation: When God showers His Mercy, servant Nanak is emancipated. ||8||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਲਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: solah asatapadeeaa guaareree gauRee keeaa ||
lines.translation: Sixteen Ashtpadheeyaa Of Gwaarayree Gauree||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਗਾਈ ਕਉ ਗੋਇਲੀ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu gaaee kau goilee raakhahi kar saaraa ||
lines.translation: As the dairy farmer watches over and protects his cows, so does the Lord cherish and protect us, night and day. He blesses the soul with peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਾਲਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis paalahi raakh lehi aatam sukh dhaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Please protect me here and hereafter, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: it ut raakhahu deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary; please bless me with Your Glance of Grace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau saranaagat nadar nihaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there You are. Save me, O Savior Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਖੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhau tah rav rahe rakh raakhanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver, and You are the Enjoyer;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) daataa bhugataa too(n)hai too(n) praan adhaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: You are the Support of the breath of life. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਅਧ ਊਰਧੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat paiaa adh ooradhee bin giaan beechaaraa ||
lines.translation: According to the karma of past actions, people descend to the depths or rise to the heights, unless they contemplate spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨ ਅੰਧਿਆਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin upamaa jagadees kee binasai na a(n)dhiaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the darkness is not dispelled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag binasat ham dekhiaa lobhe aha(n)kaaraa ||
lines.translation: I have seen the world being destroyed by greed and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa prabh paaiaa sach mukat duaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: Only by serving the Guru is God obtained, and the true gate of liberation found. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਕੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar mahal apaar ko apara(n)par soee ||
lines.translation: The Mansion of the Infinite Lord's Presence is within the home of one's own being. He is beyond any boundaries.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai thir ko nahee boojhai sukh hoee ||5||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, nothing shall endure. Through understanding, peace is obtained. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਿਆ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa lai aaiaa le jaai kiaa phaasahi jam jaalaa ||
lines.translation: What have you brought, and what will you take away, when you are caught by the noose of Death?

lines.gurmukhi: ਡੋਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਸਿ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: dol badhaa kas jevaree aakaas pataalaa ||6||
lines.translation: Like the bucket tied to the rope in the well, you are pulled up to the Akaashic Ethers, and then lowered down to the nether regions of the underworld. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat naam na veesarai sahaje pat paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and do not forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall automatically obtain honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad nidhaan hai mil aap gavaaeeai ||7||
lines.translation: Deep within the self is the treasure of the Shabad; it is obtained only by eradicating selfishness and conceit. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare prabh aapanee gun a(n)k samaavai ||
lines.translation: When God bestows His Glance of Grace, people settle in the Lap of the Virtuous Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਲਾਹਾ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak mel na chookaee laahaa sach paavai ||8||1||17||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this Union cannot be broken; the true profit is obtained. ||8||1||17||
